subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class III

source.read: NCERT, Learning Outcomes at the Elementary Stage (2017), English section, read through a copy hosted by the Indian Education Repository (CPR India); CBSE circular 05/2019 asks schools to use it; Class III list
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. A copy of the NCERT document, read through a text summary of the PDF, not the PDF itself. The class books have since changed (Mridang for Classes 1-2, Santoor for 3-5, Poorvi for 6-8, under NCF-SE 2023); their chapters are not listed here and a school may order or extend these outcomes.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.

outcomes.text: Says poems with clear sounds and the right rise and fall.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Acts out role plays and short skits with expression.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Gives a view about stories and characters.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Answers spoken and telephone messages suitably.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Reads aloud with clear sounds and pauses.

outcomes.text: Reads short texts for the main idea, details and order, and draws conclusions.
Reads poems, posters and charts on classroom walls.
outcomes.note: Poems, notices and timetables are read with questions; the classroom's own walls are not.

outcomes.text: Writes words, phrases and sentences from dictation.
Writes five or six sentences about own experiences from word or picture clues.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Uses question marks, full stops and capital letters correctly.
Makes short sentences with nouns, pronouns, adjectives and prepositions.
Tells the simple past from the simple present.
Knows opposites such as day and night, open and close.
Uses words met in Maths and Environmental Studies.
outcomes.note: New words teaches everyday and school words by level; it is not sorted by school subject.
